name: orx-parallel-wasm

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/client.test.mjs test/build.test.mjs test/vite.test.mjs
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('src/vite.js','dist/vite.js'); fs.cpSync('src/build.js','dist/build.js'); fs.cpSync('src/prepare.js','dist/prepare.js'); try{ fs.cpSync('src/vite.d.ts','dist/vite.d.ts') }catch(e){} try{ fs.cpSync('src/build.d.ts','dist/build.d.ts') }catch(e){} try{ fs.cpSync('src/prepare.d.ts','dist/prepare.d.ts') }catch(e){}"

description: Build and integrate orx-parallel Rust->WASM bindings with Vite and worker runtimes.
